items.name: Attributes
items.summary: Attributes provided to a `Subscriber` describing a new span when it is created.

methods.name: child_of
methods.signature: fn child_of(parent: Id, metadata: &'static Metadata<'static>, values: &'a field::ValueSet<'a>) -> Self
methods.summary: Returns `Attributes` describing a new child span of the specified parent span, with the provided metadata and values.

methods.name: contains
methods.summary: Returns `true` if this set of `Attributes` contains a value for the given `Field`.

methods.name: fields
methods.summary: Returns the set of all [fields] defined by this span's [`Metadata`].

methods.name: is_contextual
methods.summary: Returns true if the new span's parent should be determined based on the current context.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.summary: Returns true if this set of `Attributes` contains _no_ values.

methods.name: is_root
methods.summary: Returns true if the new span should be a root.

methods.name: metadata
methods.summary: Returns a reference to the new span's metadata.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(metadata: &'static Metadata<'static>, values: &'a field::ValueSet<'a>) -> Self
methods.summary: Returns `Attributes` describing a new child span of the current span, with the provided metadata and values.

methods.name: new_root
methods.signature: fn new_root(metadata: &'static Metadata<'static>, values: &'a field::ValueSet<'a>) -> Self
methods.summary: Returns `Attributes` describing a new span at the root of its own trace tree, with the provided metadata and values.

methods.name: parent
methods.summary: Returns the new span's explicitly-specified parent, if there is one.

methods.name: record
methods.summary: Records all the fields in this set of `Attributes` with the provided [Visitor].

methods.name: values
methods.summary: Returns a reference to a `ValueSet` containing any values the new span was created with.

methods.name: id
methods.summary: Borrows the `Id` of the current span, if one exists and is known.

methods.name: into_inner
methods.summary: Consumes `self` and returns the span `Id` and `Metadata` of the current span, if one exists and is known.

methods.name: is_known
methods.summary: Returns `true` if the `Subscriber` that constructed this `Current` tracks a current span.

methods.name: metadata
methods.summary: Borrows the `Metadata` of the current span, if one exists and is known.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(id: Id, metadata: &'static Metadata<'static>) -> Self
methods.summary: Constructs a new `Current` that indicates the current context is a span with the given `metadata` and `metadata`.

methods.name: none
methods.summary: Constructs a new `Current` that indicates the current context is *not* in a span.

items.name: Id
items.summary: Identifies a span within the context of a subscriber.

methods.name: from_non_zero_u64
methods.summary: Constructs a new span ID from the given `NonZeroU64`.

methods.name: from_u64
methods.summary: Constructs a new span ID from the given `u64`.

methods.name: into_non_zero_u64
methods.summary: Returns the span's ID as a `NonZeroU64`.

methods.name: into_u64
methods.summary: Returns the span's ID as a `u64`.

items.name: Record
items.summary: A set of fields recorded by a span.

methods.name: contains
methods.summary: Returns `true` if this `Record` contains a value for the given `Field`.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.summary: Returns true if this `Record` contains _no_ values.

methods.name: len
methods.summary: Returns the number of fields that would be visited from this `Record` when [`Record::record()`] is called

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Constructs a new `Record` from a `ValueSet`.

methods.name: record
methods.summary: Records all the fields in this `Record` with the provided [Visitor].
